slice: P6-D AC1027 bound LAYER group-390 alias consistency

repositoryEvidence.finding: The private DRW_Ac1027BoundLayer adapter stores sourcePlotStyle separately from inherited public DRW_Layer group-390 text/native fields. The writer emitted sourcePlotStyle without checking whether supplied inherited aliases disagreed.

implementation.change: writeLayer validates an explicit inherited group-390 handle against DRW_Ac1027BoundLayer::sourcePlotStyle before starting output. Conflicts now fail through the existing transactional writer path.

focusedTest.coverage: Generated AC1027 ASCII and Binary exports with bound handle 0x123 and conflicting inherited group-390 handle 0x456 refuse while preserving a destination sentinel. Clearing the inherited text alias on the same writer permits retry; fresh DXF readback sees group 390 as 123.

limits: The test proves alias consistency and serialized handle output, not existence of the referenced PlotStyleName object or recursive ownership closure.
No native DXF consumer or plot-style semantic roundtrip was run.
